title: Naturality of the braiding
statement:
Let $(\mathcal C,\otimes,\mathbf 1)$ be a monoidal category (notation as in [det-def-sfb-ring-object-monoid]) with braiding $\beta_{X,Y}:X\otimes Y\to Y\otimes X$. For all morphisms $f:X\to Y$ and $g:X'\to Y'$,
$$\beta_{Y,Y'}\circ(f\otimes g)=(g\otimes f)\circ\beta_{X,X'}.$$
